patterns.note: Sections alternate between light off-white and dark green backgrounds, creating clear visual breaks and defining content areas.
Large, bold sans-serif headlines are used for primary messaging, often centered, with smaller sans-serif text for supporting details and elegant serif fonts for testimonials.
A deep forest green is used as the primary brand color for backgrounds, navigation, and prominent text, contrasted with a soft off-white and a bright accent green for calls to action.

The main navigation bar transforms from a dark green background with white text to a white background with dark green text and logo as the user scrolls down, while the top announcement banner disappears.

The hero headline 'Interview everyone. Hire the best.' appears to be a persistent element that transitions from the initial hero section into the footer, changing its background context from light to dark green.
Testimonial sections feature a circular profile image next to a quote, with company logos below, arranged in a horizontal scrollable carousel.

technique_notes: Uses CSS keyframes and/or GSAP to animate the navigation bar's background and text color on scroll, creating a sticky header transformation. Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, often paired with a background color change. The hero headline appears to be a fixed or sticky element that changes its visual context as the page scrolls.
Full-bleed sections with generous vertical padding are used to create an airy, modern feel. Content is often centered or arranged in two-column layouts with images and text.
Testimonial cards are presented in a horizontal carousel, likely using Swiper.js, allowing users to swipe through multiple entries.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, modern feel, complemented by smaller, readable sans-serif body text and occasional elegant serif quotes.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and some card elements have a slight corner rounding, but most elements are sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical and horizontal padding between sections and elements, creating a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The most distinctive design choice is the persistent hero headline that appears to transition from the initial hero section into the footer, changing its background context from light to dark green. This creates a strong, memorable brand statement that anchors the user's experience throughout the page.
